notify.statinkAuthMessage: Upload failed because the stat.ink API key is invalid. Check Settings. Unsent battles will be sent next time (nothing is lost).
notify.statinkFailMessage: stat.ink is unavailable. Unsent battles will be sent next time (nothing is lost).

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Language for the app UI. Follow system uses the OS locale.
settings.loginNeeded: A Nintendo Account is required to fetch battle data.
settings.statinkHint: — get an API key from your profile page.
settings.devUploadDisabled: ⚠ Dev builds (0.0.0-dev) disable stat.ink upload so real data is not sent by mistake.
settings.importHint: Import your past battles stored on stat.ink into the local database. Battles SplatNet 3 no longer keeps can still be included (duplicates are skipped).
settings.importConfirm:
This downloads all of your battles from stat.ink.
It may take a few minutes. Continue?
settings.companionHint: Serve fetched gear and recent battles to the SpLabo viewer app on the same network (Wi-Fi or wired LAN). It never talks to Nintendo APIs. Sync runs only while enabled and stops when the app quits.
settings.companionQr: Scan this QR code in SpLabo viewer on your phone to pair.
settings.companionNoLan: ⚠ Could not get a LAN IP address. Check your network connection.
settings.companionPublicNet: ⚠ This network is set to Public in Windows. The firewall will block the phone, so scanning the QR will not connect. Switch to a Private network (Settings → Network & internet → current connection → Network profile type). If a allow dialog appears on first connect, check Private and allow.
settings.companionFwHint: If it still will not connect on a Private network, the firewall allow rule may exist only for Public (you allowed it while Public, then switched). Rules do not carry across profiles. wf.msc → Inbound Rules → splabo → Properties → Advanced → check Private. There are usually two splabo rules (TCP / UDP); check both.
settings.autoFetch: Auto-fetch (stays in the tray when on)
settings.masterHint: Fetches weapons, subs, specials, categories, official-app freshness / wins / turf / last used / Challenge Power, stage win rates, and all weapon images from SplatNet 3. On startup, at most once per 24 hours. During auto-fetch, only when there are new battles and at least 6 hours have passed. You can also run it manually.
settings.envDataHint: Public stat.ink battles. Incremental updates are on the Meta tab; change the start date and re-import here. Default is 2025-01-01 onward (all-time is heavy; the ZIP is about 980 MiB).
settings.envRefetchConfirm:
This deletes meta data and re-imports {{range}}. {{zipNote}}

Continue?
settings.envZipDaily: Daily CSVs will be used (no ZIP).
settings.envImported: Imported {{count}} rows. Check the Meta tab.
settings.gearDataHint: Deletes all fetched gear (list and image cache). Fetch again from Fetch latest data in the sidebar.
settings.gearDeleteConfirm:
This deletes all fetched gear (list and image cache).
The Gear tab will be empty until you fetch again from Fetch latest data. Continue?
settings.gearDeleted: Gear data deleted. The Gear tab will be empty after reload.
settings.dashboardResetHint: Remove every custom chart and restore the dashboard to the built-in four charts.
settings.gearDisplayHint: Gear tab layout and loadout search. Density changes apply the next time you open the Gear tab.
settings.aiPriceNote: Prices and context length as of May 2026. See each provider’s pricing page for current numbers.

chart.needXY: Pick an X axis and a Y axis for the scatter plot.
chart.notImplemented: This chart type ({{shape}}) is not implemented yet.
chart.notImplementedLater: It will come in a later update.

dashboard.emptyDesc: Fetch the latest battles and gear from SplatNet 3 to see win-rate charts and breakdowns by weapon and stage.
dashboard.emptyStep1: First, sign in with a Nintendo Account in {{settings}}

books.name: Name
books.noStageWeapons: No weapon records on this stage.
books.updateMasterHint: Settings › Master data › Update weapon data.
books.fetchThenRetry: Fetch the latest data, then open this tab again.

chartConfig.unimplementedHint: This chart type is not in v1.0.0. Planned for v1.1+.
chartConfig.lineTimeHint: Line charts are time-only. Pick a bucket: {{buckets}}.
chartConfig.yDiffHint: Pick a different axis from X.
chartConfig.topNBar: Top N of the current sort (default {{n}}).
chartConfig.officialHint: All-time values from the official app. They ignore the filters above.
chartConfig.singleBarHint: Bar chart of a single metric.
chartConfig.imageHint: Size and color are off (the image fills the point). Use a smaller size when dots overlap.
chartConfig.imageAvailableHint: On the weapon axis, points can be weapon images.
chartConfig.logHintRate: Win rate stays in 0–100%, so log scale is not available.
chartConfig.logHint: Makes long tails and ratios (K/D) easier to read. Points at 0 or below, and ∞, are dropped.
chartConfig.colorHintBattle: Color and shape can show result, or weapon class / sub / special.
chartConfig.colorHintWeapon: Besides numeric metrics, color and shape can show weapon class / sub / special.
chartConfig.colorHintOther: Win rate uses a muted coral↔lime↔teal scale; others use accent shades.
chartConfig.yCompSingle: One metric on Y (win rate, battles, K/D, …).
chartConfig.yCompStacked: Stacked W/L/D bars with a win-rate line. Same shape as the built-in four charts.
chartConfig.yCompAttack: Per category, average kills (assists stacked in gray) and average deaths as a pair.
